Apache-2.0 bbpPairings v6.0.0 (Jeremy Bierema / Bierema Boyz Programming).
Downloaded by `pnpm fetch:bbp` (`node scripts/fetch-bbp-pairings.mjs`) from
https://github.com/BieremaBoyzProgramming/bbpPairings/releases/tag/v6.0.0

Binaries are not committed. Docker (`deploy/Dockerfile.api`) and desktop CI
(`.github/workflows/desktop-release.yml`) fetch them. There is no official
macOS binary in v6.0.0 — Mac Dutch pairings use the cloud API.

CLI: `bbpPairings.exe --dutch input.trf -p output.txt`
